chunks: I have narrated from him many signs, and the miracles of the Imam appeared through his hand, and matters that he informed them about from him increased their insight in this matter, and they are well-known among the Shias, and we have previously presented a portion of them, so we will not prolong by repeating them, for indeed in that is sufficient for the fair-minded, if God wills.
ai.seo_question: What evidence of the Imam's miracles increased the Shia's faith according to Tusi?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Tusi highlights the proliferation of miracles (mu'jizat) and prophetic predictions attributed to the Imam, which served as definitive proofs (dalā'il) for the Shia community during the Minor Occultation. By referencing these well-known signs, he emphasizes that the accumulated evidence is sufficient for the 'fair-minded' (al-manṣif) to accept the Imam's authority without requiring exhaustive repetition of every miracle.
